Verification

Verification numbers
MeasureValue
Cells1016 (127 rows x 8 columns): 680 supported, 238 partial, 96 undocumented, 2 not exposed. 695 verified, 321 unverified.
Errors found by the sample5 distinct cells of 374 checked were wrong (4 overreach, 1 wrong state). All 5 were revised and re-verified. Codex CLI crossed the 5% sampled-error line, so all its supported cells were checked: 0 unverified.
Lever records497 records (27 lever rows x 8 columns). A script checks that every literal, value, default and model name appears in a cited quote or its URL; a tester pass with 2 planted errors per column found 2 real records with a location kind the quotes do not show; both were corrected.
Lever slice (256 cells)Every cell verified: script quote check, tester-qa on 100%, code-reviewer on 100%, planted errors in every wave. 38 undocumented cells carry a sweep report.
Other 760 cellstester-qa on every partial and not-exposed cell and a 30% stratified sample of supported cells (374 distinct cells checked); code-reviewer on every flagged cell. 58 undocumented cells carry a hand-read sweep report; 7 cells flipped to a documented state after the sweeps and were verified.
Planted errorsEvery planted error was caught: 49 of 49 in the cell waves, 7 of 7 in the re-check packs, 16 of 16 in the lever-record check.
Register55 entries. Every repo quote, blob SHA, path and ceiling quote is script-checked; the evidence factor and score are derived. An opus reviewer fact-checked the top 22 and ordered the top 15: 21 of 22 held, one became a probe.
Unverified cells by columnclaude-code 53, codex-cli 0, copilot-cli 50, copilot-vscode 38, cursor 48, gemini-cli 52, grok-build 47, grok-bot 33. Each is a supported cell outside the sample, carries a settles_by line and shows the unverified marker.

Known gaps

  • All eight columns are documentation as mirrored on 2026-10-04. Source trees (evidence tier E3) and executed probes (E4) are separate tiers that later phases fill, and most cells carry E1 or E2 evidence only.
  • Claude Code: only the English pages are mirrored (220 of the 2,617 URLs in the sitemap; 11 other languages carry 218 pages each). docs/en/claude-tag redirects to claude.com and was refused by the host allow-list. Three pages linked from fetched pages (architecture, build-and-test, debugging) answered 404 when fetched.
  • Codex: 28 mirrored pages about ChatGPT products (dots, Space, ChatGPT Work, custom-GPT migration, voice) are not read. docs/changelog exists only as a 1.5 MB HTML shell and docs/screenshot-review answered 404 on its HTML and .md forms although the sitemap lists it. The index lists two guides (best-practices, build-ai-native-engineering-team) whose .md URLs answered 404. About 100 /use-cases pages and the docs home page are out of scope. The 2.9 MB codex-manual.md aggregate is mirrored as a cross-check and never read.
  • Copilot CLI: of 3,191 docs paths in the Page List API, 155 matched the harness rule. Copilot on github.com, the Copilot SDK and most administration pages are not read. The Page List API is incomplete: four in-scope pages that fetched pages link to were absent from it and were added by link closure.
  • Copilot in VS Code: the monthly release notes (1.140 is current) are HTML only and are not mirrored. The AI Toolkit (Intelligent Apps) pages are out of scope. docs/chat/chat-debug-view is linked from a fetched page and answered 404. The index carries a broken /undefined entry, which was dropped.
  • Cursor: the product changelog exists only as HTML, and the index line for it is malformed (a doubled host), so only its newest entry date was read, as the version source. The CLI and SDK changelogs are mirrored. The Origin git forge, the API reference, billing and member administration pages are out of scope. Three changelog entry pages are HTML only.
  • Gemini CLI: one aggregate file (llms.txt, 960 KB) is the only source for all 97 pages, and its page URLs are written with http://. The 184-byte sitemap-index.xml was rejected as too short; its child sitemap was read and lists the same 97 pages.
  • Grok Build: the documentation publishes no version number and grok version was not run. docs.x.ai serves the Grok 4.7 model page as an HTML app shell; its markdown twin was read instead.
  • Grok Bot: a hosted service with no version. The Slack authorization link on the team-bots page redirects to slack.com and was refused by the host allow-list. Cursor-hosted mirrors and help pages supplement the 21 canonical xAI pages.
  • Recall: candidate buckets were keyed on the scouts' row tags, so an empty or off-topic bucket did not prove absence. Adjacent-row candidates and hand-read sweeps closed part of that gap, not all. A cell that reads undocumented means a sweep of the mirrored corpus found nothing the reviewer accepted, with a positive control hit; it is not proof the vendor publishes nothing.
  • Table cells that carry only an icon (a check or a cross) are not captured by the extractor, so a feature shown that way in a comparison table can read undocumented or partial.
  • Claude Code holds about 53% of all evidence records (23,161 of 43,833), so its column is the best covered and the cross-column comparison is uneven for that reason.
  • Install and update command lines are stored as described spans with no quote, so they support a cell but have no script-checked quote.
  • 321 supported cells are unverified: they were outside the 30% verification sample. The per-column counts are on this page; each carries a settles_by line.
